items.quote: thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so
items.claim: The text says Moses was told to strike the rock, that water would come out of it for the people to drink, and that Moses did so.
items.mechanism: Striking the rock, as instructed, makes water come out so the people can drink.

items.quote: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb
items.claim: The text places the divine instruction and presence at the rock in Horeb.

items.quote: And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
items.claim: The text says Moses struck the rock in front of the elders of Israel, so they saw it happen.
items.action: did so in the sight of the elders
items.mechanism: The elders of Israel watched it happen.
